temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl appears stressed and overwhelmed by paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project; Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria had no specific belief that Cheryl was currently overwhelmed or needed assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Updated: Maria learned that Cheryl is indeed overwhelmed but welcomes help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl needs and appreciates assistance with the project, and Maria can help her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Cheryl with the paperwork and planning.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria observes Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing in confidence; at the staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase, Team Leader supports, and Cheryl accepts and thanks Maria.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has improved in handling responsibilities and is gaining confidence, with potential for more responsibility.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed and strengthened: Team Leader endorses the suggestion and Cheryl accepts the leadership role willingly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is ready and willing to lead the next phase of the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role.

temporal_state_chain.observed: In a private conversation, Cheryl tells Maria she was a bit surprised by the suggestion but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria worries that her leadership suggestion might have seemed like overstepping or might have pressured Cheryl.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Revised: Cheryl was surprised but did not feel harmed; she appreciates Maria's support and honesty.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl values Maria's support, and there is no misunderstanding or hard feeling.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relieved and reassured after initial worry.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To ensure Cheryl feels supported and to maintain trust in their relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria proposes co-leading; Cheryl says it sounds fantastic, calls Maria's guidance invaluable, and agrees they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support, and believes continued collaboration may be positive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Expanded and confirmed: Cheryl enthusiastically accepts co-leading and values Maria's guidance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl can co-lead effectively and support each other as a team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria sees that she and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects and their partnership has strengthened; Cheryl responds enthusiastically to teaming up for more future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their partnership is strong and their collaboration is fruitful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed and strengthened: Cheryl is eager to continue working together on future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: They will continue to collaborate successfully and achieve more together in the future.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl for more future projects.
